audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[1] says 'Use Ultra Mega Fire Kick (R) to cleanse your R root and disengage.' Ultra Mega Fire Kick is Milio's Q, not his R — his R is Breath of Life, which is the actual cleanse. It also calls Lux's root 'your R root' but Lux's root is her Q (Light Binding); her R is a damage beam with no CC.
audit.why: packet.suspectNames flags this exact string (distance 4, 'ultra mega fire kick'), and enemyKit confirms Ultra Mega Fire Kick is Q while Breath of Life (R) is the cleanse/heal. ownerKit confirms Lux's only root is Q.
audit.corrected: Use Breath of Life (R) to cleanse your Q root and then disengage

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[0..6].side all read the placeholder 'Skill' in the full layer while content win[0..5] already say 'Lux' and win[6] says 'Milio' — the page would render two different answers for who wins each stage.
audit.why: THE CHART RULE: full .side and content win[N] are one unit and must name the same side. win[N] here is already correct (matches packet.levelChart: Lux through level 6, Milio at 2+ items), so only .side needs to move to agree with it — no win[N] edit needed since it's not changing.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no cooldown numbers (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT), and dosFull[1].d / dontsFull[2].d were verbatim copies of tradeGood/tradeBad pasted under unrelated titles (lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED).
audit.why: Breath of Life is 160/145/130s and Cozy Campfire is 29/27/25/23/21s — real numbers make the sustain-timing advice concrete instead of vague. missingInteractions also flags that Grievous Wounds timing against his W/R sustain isn't stated anywhere else on the page besides the itemization report line.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now cites 160/145/130s (R) and 29-21s (W) with anti-heal timing; dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d rewritten to match their own titles instead of restating tradeGood/tradeBad.

edits.before: Use Ultra Mega Fire Kick (R) to cleanse your R root and disengage
edits.after: Use Breath of Life (R) to cleanse your Q root and then disengage

edits.before: - Milio Breath of Life: matchup-defining — The team-wide cleanse-heal undoes your CC chain — force it early, engage after. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep W Prismatic Barrier banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: Breath of Life (R) is 160/145/130s and cleanses your whole CC chain — force your root before it's up, not into it. Cozy Campfire (W) heals on a 29-21s cooldown; anti-heal timed to when it's down cuts his sustain hardest, and his E shield resets in 0.5s so poke still lands.

edits.before: E the contact, detonate, passive-auto, bank the Q visibly — the chip is free and the threat governs.
edits.after: Hold Q until his E shields are down or Fire Kick (Q) is spent — the root converts clean, no bail-out.

edits.before: Q-poking on cooldown until the hook learns the rhythm — the binding is the lane's law; spend it like one.
edits.after: Don't burn W (Barrier) on his chip poke — save it for when Breath of Life is down and CC actually sticks.

notes: wants.foe[1] had both a wrong ability name (Q vs R) and a wrong slot for Lux's own root (Q vs R) — same sentence, two errors. Level chart side/content mismatch was a straightforward 'Skill' placeholder never replaced; content layer was already correct so only side moved.
